statement: docs/contract.json was transcribed from the rendered VCF Automation xAPIs reference pages listed below. Reference documentation, not a published API specification, is the source of that contract.

specificationAbsence.finding: The repository publishes no VCF Automation, Aria Automation or vRealize Automation specification, so no pinned specification file could be used as the contract source.

apiTitle: VCF Automation API | VM Apps Org - Catalog
retrievalMethod: Each page below was fetched over HTTPS from developer.broadcom.com and read as rendered documentation.

pages.documents: The Broadcom Developer Portal xAPIs index, used to locate the VCF Automation API families for VCF 9.1.
The VCF Automation API landing page for the VM Apps Org - Catalog family, giving the API title, the 9.1 version selector and the /catalog/api and /deployment/api operation groups.
The operation index, used to confirm the exact method, path and rendered title of every operation transcribed into docs/contract.json.

GET /catalog/api/items "Get Catalog Items": the paginated catalog item list, its eleven optional query parameters page, size, sort, search, projects, types, expandProjects, expand, $top, $skip and $orderby, and the PageCatalogItem response.

POST /catalog/api/items/{id}/request "Request Catalog Item Instances": the required id path parameter, the CatalogItemRequest body whose six members bulkRequestCount, deploymentName, inputs, projectId, reason and version are all optional, and the array of CatalogItemRequestResponse returned on 200.

GET /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId} "Get Deployment By Id": the required deploymentId path parameter, the deprecated expandResources, expandLastRequest and expandProject query parameters, the non-deprecated expand and deleted query parameters, and the Deployment response.

POST /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId}/requests "Submit Deployment Action Request": the required deploymentId path parameter, the ResourceActionRequest body whose three members actionId, inputs and reason are all optional, and the documented 200, 401, 403, 404 and 409 status codes.
The CatalogItem structure, supplying the id, name, projectIds, isRequestable and type members used to select a catalog item.
The CatalogItemRequest body structure and the optionality, types and length limits of its six members.
The CatalogItemRequestResponse structure returned when a catalog item request creates a deployment, carrying deploymentId and deploymentName.
The Deployment structure and the nine values of its status enum, from CREATE_SUCCESSFUL through DELETE_FAILED.
The Request structure returned by a deployment action request and the twelve values of its status enum, from CREATED through FAILED.
